requirement: Create a multi-tier SaaS dependency tree: get_api_key -> get_tenant_context -> get_scoped_repository with generator yield and finally: repo.close(), admin tenant override guard, and dependency caching.
skeleton: FastAPI multi-tier dependency hierarchy with generator lifecycle management and role-based tenant routing.

rationale.teaches: A three-level dependency chain where the leaf is a generator with finally-close, an admin-only tenant override, and default dependency caching so one request builds one repository.
rationale.why: Dependency trees are assembled from snippets that each look right in isolation. Whether the repo closes, whether a non-admin can hop tenants, and whether the cache is on can only be seen by exercising the whole chain, which the fixture does.

candidates.why_wrong: The repository is yielded without a finally block, so a route that raises leaves it open.
Any authenticated user can override the tenant, so a regular user reads another tenant's data.
The admin override is ignored and the home tenant is used, so the override header has no effect.
The dependency returns the repository instead of yielding it, so close is never called at all.
use_cache=False rebuilds the repository for every parameter that depends on it, so one request opens multiple repositories.
